root_cause: The inherited runner declared the task modes but had no P03-002 Verify, Security, WorksetVerify, Evidence, or RollbackVerify adapter.
impact: Mechanical task evidence only; the runtime implementation and isolated PostgreSQL data were not affected.
repair: Added one task-scoped reversible runner adapter and reran every affected mode.
rollback: Revert the adapter when an equivalent approved runner supersedes it; the product migration remains independently reversible.
recovery_condition: All affected task modes return exact card assertions with no skip or xfail.
